searchProviders.label: Search Providers
searchProviders.description: Engines the New Tab box can send a query to. %s in the URL is replaced with the URL-encoded query.

urlTemplate.label: URL Template
urlTemplate.description: Search URL with %s where the query goes.

defaultProvider.label: Default Search Provider
defaultProvider.description: The provider the New Tab box starts on. Pick another one per search from its dropdown.

newTabParent.label: New Tab Location
newTabParent.description: Where a New Tab files the Web View note it creates.

options.label: Under the note the button was pressed from

newTabParentNoteId.label: Specific Note
newTabParentNoteId.description: Used when New Tab Location is set to "Under a specific note".

showSaveButton.label: Save Button
showSaveButton.description: Adds a Save button to the toolbar that files the page you are reading as a Web View note somewhere permanent.

saveParentNoteId.label: Save Location
saveParentNoteId.description: Where Save files the note. Left empty, it uses the note labelled #inbox.

syncNoteTitle.label: Follow Page Title
syncNoteTitle.description: Names the Web View note after the loaded page's title whenever the page reports a new one. A title you set yourself is kept; rename a note back to the page's title to hand it back to this setting.

reuseExistingNotes.label: Reuse Existing Notes
reuseExistingNotes.description: Before making a Web View note, looks for one anywhere in the tree already pointing at the same URL and clones that one instead, so the same page is a single note in several places.

sponsorBlockEnabled.label: Skip Sponsor Segments
sponsorBlockEnabled.description: Skips crowd-sourced segments of YouTube videos played in a Web View note. Each video's segments are looked up on sponsor.ajay.app, which is asked about a hash prefix rather than the video id, so it never learns which video is playing.

sponsorBlockNotify.label: Show A Notice On Skip
sponsorBlockNotify.description: Shows a short "Skipped: Sponsor" notice in the corner of the page each time a segment is skipped.

skipSponsor.label: Sponsor
skipSponsor.description: Paid promotion, paid referrals and direct advertisements.

skipSelfPromo.label: Unpaid / Self Promotion
skipSelfPromo.description: The creator's own merch, Patreon or other videos.

skipInteraction.label: Interaction Reminder
skipInteraction.description: Brief reminders to like, subscribe or comment.

skipIntro.label: Intro
skipIntro.description: Intro animations and pauses with no content.

skipPreview.label: Preview / Recap
skipPreview.description: Recaps of this video's own content, or previews of what's coming.

skipMusicOfftopic.label: Non-Music Section
skipMusicOfftopic.description: In a music video, the parts that are not music.

skipFiller.label: Filler Tangent
skipFiller.description: Tangents and jokes that add no information.
